Data Analyst Job at Sundry Foods




        
    

        
        Sundry Foods is an integrated food services company founded in 2003 and operating in major cities in Nigeria. We are bringing our now trademark great tasting ready-to-eat food and quality services to thousands of people and institutions daily through its chain and network of restaurants, bakeries and other catering facilities.

We are proud to own and operate one of Africa’s best restaurant and bakery chains and we pride ourselves on our ability to consistently deliver original food and service solutions whether in workplaces, schools and colleges, hospitals, joining even remote sites and different cultural environments using our team of young seasoned professionals and an entire workforce with a passion to deliver nothing but the best to every customer.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Data Analyst

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers

Responsibilties


	The Data Analyst will collate, analyze and interpret raw and complex data into usable information and present the findings in a visually intuitive manner to business stakeholders for appropriate decision making.


The role holder will work with our business leaders to:


	Identify trends and opportunities for improvement using data
	Establish and monitor operations performance management metrics, policies, and processes
	Design, and build customized dashboards to manage and monitor information, inputs and outputs across the organization
	Devise and implement efficient and secure procedures for data management and analysis to ensure adequacy, accuracy, and legitimacy of data
	Analyze and interpret performance data and reports related to products, sales, expense etc to identify trends and generate appropriate courses of action
	Recommend and establish efficient ways to organize, store and analyze data with attention to security and confidentiality.
	Establish rules and procedures for data sharing with upper management, process owners, external stakeholders
	Recommend and establish efficient ways to organize, store and analyze data with attention to security and confidentiality.


Required Qualification


	B.Sc Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science or other related courses.


Required Skill:


	Advanced Microsoft Excel Skills, Reporting and data visualization skills using software like Tableau, Analytical Skills, Computer Skills, Presentation Skills.

title: Job Openings at Saro Agrosciences
content:
Saro Agrosciences is the flagship company of Saroafrica International group and was established in 1991 as Saro Pharma & Chemical Co. Limited.

Saro Agrosciences has grown into a leading player in the agriculture industry. We are passionately committed to empowering the Nigerian farmer with superior agro-inputs like crop protection products, seeds, fertilizers, and knowledge that will enable these farmers to increase their yield and livelihood in a sustainable manner.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Market Sales Representative / Sales Representative

Job Location: Idah, Kogi
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	He/she ensures wholesales, & retail customers in assigned open markets are served; and Saro Agrosciences products are always available & visible at the retail / wholesalers’ outlets in assigned open markets.


Primary Responsibilities


	Prepares route plan & adhere to it strictly.
	Develop & maintain customer list that capture Name, Contact Person, Address, and Phone Numbers of customers in assigned markets.
	Sell company products to current & potential wholesale / retail outlets & customers.
	Deliver set targets on all sales KPIs- Call, IMS, Collection, Strike Rate, Average Order Size/Call etc.
	Ensure products are sold as communicated in official company price list in all sales outlets.
	Develop existing & new wholesale / retail customers to achieve daily, weekly, monthly, & annual volume / revenue targets.
	Ensures sales to customers are done on cash basis; and Cr. Limits are approved / adhered to where applicable.
	Report issues relating to / satisfaction of customers, & consumers in assigned markets.
	Assist in the development (information generation) and implementation of marketing plans regarding his / her assigned territory.
	Merchandize & execute products display initiatives leading to the desired visibilities for company brands in the retail outlets trade channels.


Special Skills & Key Behavioral Competencies:


	Smart
	Good numeric ability
	Computer literate
	Resident of the target area
	Ability to communicate fluently in the local languages of the area
	High integrity and must be able to work under pressure.
	Good knowledge of target Market
	Resident of the target area


Salary
N100,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 3rd August, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) Van Sales Representative

Job Location: Magboro, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	He/she is responsible for using a Vehicle to ensure retail customers are served; and Saro Agrosciences products are available & visible across in assigned routes at all times


Responsibilities


	Prepares route plan & adhere to it strictly.
	Develop & maintain customer list that capture Name, Contact Person, Address, and Phone Numbers of customers in assigned routes.
	Sell company products to current & potential retail outlets / customers.
	Deliver set targets on all sales KPIs- Call, IMS, Collection, Strike Rate, Average Order Size/Call etc.
	Ensure products are sold as communicated in official company price list in all sales outlets
	Ensure proper maintenance of the van is carried out in accordance with guidelines.
	Maintain a driver's logbook showing details of itineraries, fuel consumption, maintenance records, etc.
	Assist in the development (information generation) and implementation of marketing plans regarding his / her assigned territory.
	Report issues relating to satisfaction of customers, & consumers in assigned routes.
	Develop existing & new retail customers to achieve daily, weekly, monthly, & annual volume / revenue targets.


Special Skills & Key behavioral Competencies


	Good Communication skill
	Good interpersonal skills
	High integrity and must be able to work under pressure
	Must be able to speak the local language of the area
	Computer literate
	Must be resident in City of interest
	Possess valid drivers’ license.


Salary
N100,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 3rd August, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Junior Production Engineer

Job Location: Along Lagos Ibadan expressway, Close to Magboro or Mount of Fire Church - Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose


	The Junior Production Engineer supports the efficient, safe, and cost-effective execution of production operations by planning and monitoring manufacturing activities, optimizing production processes, ensuring product quality, maintaining compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards, and coordinating equipment maintenance to achieve production targets while driving continuous improvement.


Duties/Responsibilities


	Production Execution: Develop and implement daily and weekly production schedules to meet volume and delivery targets.
	Process Optimization: Monitor production operations, identify equipment bottlenecks, and apply continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma to reduce waste and improve yield.
	Quality Assurance: Oversee chemical formulation processes and ensure all batches meet required standards for concentration, purity, and physical properties.
	Health, Safety & Environment (HSE): Ensure compliance with safety procedures, proper use of PPE, safe handling of hazardous materials, and adherence to environmental regulations.
	Equipment & Maintenance: Coordinate with the maintenance team to execute routine and preventive maintenance on filling systems, capping machines, packaging lines, and chemical reactors.
	Team Support: Assist in supervising, monitoring, training, and supporting production operators and junior staff to ensure smooth plant operations. Required Skills/Abilities:
	Strong computer proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Office applications and production data management. • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
	Knowledge of chemical manufacturing or formulation processes will be an added advantage.
	Demonstrated willingness to learn and adapt in a production environment.


Education and Experience


	Bachelor's Degree (minimum of a Second Class Upper) in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, Chemistry, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
	2-4 years of experience in similar role in a similar role
	Age Requirement: 26 – 30 Years.


Application Closing Date: 31st July, 2026.

title: Job Openings at Linkup Human Capital Limited
content:
Linkup Human Capital Limited is an indigenous, leading management consulting firm in Nigeria, a workforce solutions provider that renders professional services and solutions in areas that span multiple industries and has been immensely successful in creating a global network of highly adept intelligent workforce that can help a company achieve its mission/critical projects and goals. We focus on delivering value to organizations, which in turn increases the bottom line of their business.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Technical Assistant

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Project Management: Oversee project lifecycles from design to completion, including BOQ and drawing reviews; provide technical and analytical aid, executive briefings, and track deliverables for the CDO
	Technical Fit-Outs: Manage technical fit-out elements (HVAC, MEP, IT) for project readiness
	Operations & Maintenance: Track maintenance performance, infrastructure reliability, and customer experience
	Expansion & Analysis: Analyze site data and acquisition pipelines, and support regional expansion
	Asset & Procurement Management: Collaborate on asset tracking and ensure alignment between procurement and finance
	Reporting & Dashboards: Develop project/facility dashboards and generate actionable insights through reporting
	Quality Management: Authorize SOPs and workflows to ensure ISO-aligned Quality Management Systems
	Systems & Automation: Support ERP implementation, process automation, and data structure optimization
	Documentation & Knowledge: Manage internal documentation systems and institutional knowledge workflows
	Cross-Functional Liaison: Act as a bridge between operational teams, finance, and technical departments
	Process Improvement: Proactively identify and implement process improvements to drive operational efficiency


Qualifications:


	Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (Civil/Structural Engineering, Architecture, etc.)
	Must have completed NYSC or possess an exemption certificate
	5–8 years’ experience in projects, facilities, or property management
	Quality Management Systems and Enterprise Resource Planning experience preferred
	Relevant professional certifications will be an added advantage


Key Competencies:


	Technical Acumen
	Strong Analytical Skills
	Data Analysis
	QMS & Process Development
	ERP & Systems Thinking
	Strategic Thinking


Compensation / Benefit
Very Attractive

Application Closing Date: 5th August, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their cover letter and CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only candidates who meets the above criteria will be contacted.

 

 

2.) Machine Operator

Job Location: Epe, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production machinery and equipment.
	Diagnose and repair mechanical and electrical faults.
	Conduct routine inspections to identify potential equipment issues.
	Ensure machines are operating safely and efficiently.
	Maintain maintenance records and report equipment performance.
	Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns to minimize production downtime.
	Comply with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and procedures.
	Assist with the installation and commissioning of new machinery when required.
	Keep the workshop and maintenance tools clean and organized.


Requirements


	OND, HND, or Trade Test Certificate in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
	2–3 years of experience in equipment maintenance within a manufacturing environment, preferably in the furniture or wood-processing industry.
	Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.
	Ability to read and interpret technical manuals and engineering drawings.
	Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
	Strong commitment to workplace safety.


Salary
Negotiable.

Application Closing Date: 16th August, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their cover letter and CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Safety Manager

Job Location: Epe, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Develop, implement, and monitor HSE policies, procedures, and safety management systems.
	Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations and company standards.
	Conduct routine workplace inspections, risk assessments, and safety audits to identify and mitigate hazards.
	Lead incident investigations, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
	Organize safety induction, training, and awareness programmes for employees and contractors.
	Monitor the proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and ensure adherence to safe work practices.
	Prepare and submit HSE reports, safety statistics, and regulatory documentation.
	Coordinate emergency preparedness activities, including drills and response plans.
	Work closely with production and maintenance teams to promote a safe working environment and continuous improvement.
	Foster a positive safety culture through employee engagement and regular safety campaigns.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or a related discipline.
	5–7years of proven HSE experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment; experience in furniture or wood-processing industries is an added advantage.
	Professional HSE certification (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, ISPON, OSHA, or equivalent) is highly desirable.
	Strong knowledge of occupational health, safety, and environmental regulations.
	Experience conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, and safety audits.
	Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, and report-writing skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
	Ability to work effectively under pressure and influence a strong safety culture across all levels of the organization.


Salary
Attractive and Negotiable.

Application Closing Date: 30th July, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using "Safety Manager" as the subject of the email.
